A_original_dark_or_overlay.evidence: Source 2 original crop contains dark native content but no matching rectangular region; the source-65 roi_1 native crop is dark before editing.
A_original_dark_or_overlay.counterevidence: Source 2 has 0 matching input-dark pixels at the detected rectangle coordinates; source-65 roi_1 has 810 output-dark pixels whose corresponding input pixels are above the threshold.
A_original_dark_or_overlay.confidence: LOW for source-2 rectangle; MEDIUM as a contributing baseline for source-65 roi_1
A_original_dark_or_overlay.repair: Do not treat dark source content as normal-metal evidence; improve source/context screening.

B_crop_padding_scale_design.evidence: Reflect padding is part of the frozen runner. Canvas padding is 46.68% for source 2, 77.73% for source 65 roi_0, and 4.59% for roi_1. Manual review confirms repeated metal-edge structures in source 65 roi_0's padded input.
B_crop_padding_scale_design.counterevidence: The source-2 rectangle is inside the valid content and support, and source-65 roi_1 remains semantically poor despite only 4.59% padding.
B_crop_padding_scale_design.confidence: MEDIUM as a risk factor, LOW as the sole root cause
B_crop_padding_scale_design.repair: Use a context-balanced ROI/padding policy and explicitly record content fraction before any future run.
B_crop_padding_scale_design.call_scope: One same-source source-2 call with only the padding policy changed, all other frozen variables unchanged; requires a new Gate and is not executed here.

C_raw_sdxl_output_artifact.evidence: The source-2 dark rectangle exists in the persisted raw SDXL output Canvas, has no matching dark input pixels, and maps entirely into native edit support (1172/1172; 1154/1172 in the polygon). Source-65 roi_1 also has 810 newly dark output Canvas pixels. Manual review independently confirms the black bar is visible at this stage.
C_raw_sdxl_output_artifact.counterevidence: Existing files cannot identify whether the cause is latent conditioning, decoder behavior, or model semantics internally.
C_raw_sdxl_output_artifact.confidence: HIGH that the first observed artifact stage is raw model output; LOW for the internal sub-cause
C_raw_sdxl_output_artifact.repair: Reject the outputs as pseudo-normal data; isolate model/context/prompt factors in a separately authorized test.

D_vae_fp16_numerical.evidence: All persisted outputs are finite, non-constant, and not black as reported by S2 runtime metrics.
D_vae_fp16_numerical.counterevidence: The raw output contains localized artifacts, which cannot be ruled out as a decoder interaction using post hoc PNGs alone.
D_vae_fp16_numerical.repair: Only an explicitly authorized instrumented comparison could test VAE precision; do not change precision in this audit.

E_inverse_mapping.evidence: LANCZOS-to-native reconstruction and the persisted native ROI are byte-identical inside support; nearest-vs-LANCZOS differs mildly but cannot create a rectangle already present in the Canvas.
E_inverse_mapping.counterevidence: The artifact is present before inverse mapping.
E_inverse_mapping.confidence: HIGH that inverse mapping is not the first source of the black rectangle; MEDIUM that it contributes small boundary differences
E_inverse_mapping.repair: Prefer a documented nearest/area policy for mask-aligned diagnostics; do not claim this removes model artifacts.

F_native_mask_hard_paste.evidence: Outside-support changes are zero; saved native ROI equals the LANCZOS inverse inside support and equals the original crop outside support. Source-65 seam delta rises from 4.58 to 5.80 mean RGB units for roi_0 and 4.73 to 6.02 for roi_1.
F_native_mask_hard_paste.counterevidence: The black rectangle and roi_1 dark region are already in raw Canvas output and are not outside-support paste artifacts.
F_native_mask_hard_paste.confidence: HIGH that hard paste is not the primary artifact source; MEDIUM that it can expose seams
F_native_mask_hard_paste.repair: If later authorized, test a single feathered boundary policy as a postprocess control; never use it to hide semantic defects.

G_multi_factor_inconclusive.evidence: Raw model output is the first observed stage, while extreme padding and narrow contexts plausibly affect conditioning and seam risk.
G_multi_factor_inconclusive.counterevidence: A single S2 run per ROI cannot separate model, prompt, padding, and precision sub-causes.
G_multi_factor_inconclusive.confidence: MEDIUM for the overall semantic failure being multi-factor; internal mechanism INCONCLUSIVE
G_multi_factor_inconclusive.repair: Keep the final Smoke slot reserved until a new Gate defines one-factor attribution.

repair_hypotheses_max_three.observed_anomaly: Source 2 has 46.68% padding and source 65 roi_0 has 77.73% padding.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.mechanism: Reflect-padded duplicate context may bias inpainting when valid content is a narrow band.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.single_factor: Change only the padding policy; preserve source, ROI, prompt, seed, strength, steps, model and mask.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.expected_improvement: Less duplicated-context conditioning and fewer edge-driven structures.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.risk: Source 65 roi_1 is poor with only 4.59% padding, so this cannot explain all failures.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.recommendation: CONDITIONAL_ONLY; not worth spending the last slot without a new Gate

repair_hypotheses_max_three.observed_anomaly: The edited supports occupy long, thin or very small native ROI shapes.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.mechanism: Defect-to-normal-context ratio and aspect ratio may leave insufficient representative metal context.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.single_factor: Change only a pre-registered ROI context size/aspect rule; preserve the model and all inference parameters.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.expected_improvement: More stable local texture and less dark semantic collapse.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.risk: It changes the input geometry and may introduce FOV/UI content; it needs a new source safety review.

repair_hypotheses_max_three.observed_anomaly: Postprocess seam deltas increase for source 65 after support paste.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.mechanism: Binary support paste exposes a model/native transition at the halo boundary.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.single_factor: Change only the native boundary composition to a fixed feather rule; preserve raw model output and all model settings.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.expected_improvement: Lower visible seams at support boundaries.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.risk: It cannot remove a raw Canvas artifact inside the polygon and may alter labeled pixels outside the intended edit core.
repair_hypotheses_max_three.recommendation: CPU-only diagnostic is possible; do not call it a semantic repair

last_smoke_slot.reason: The first-stage failure is raw SDXL output in two distinct ROIs, and one call cannot establish a general repair or distinguish the internal model/decoder cause.
